discovered-from:LP-0MTZRM5HV0007S0V

The slot_schedule removal (LP-0MTZRM5HV0007S0V) removes the time-based slot schedule from proxy/config.yaml, config-fast.yaml, config-cheap.yaml.

The proxy-usage-analysis skill (.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/) still parses slot_schedule from the active config to derive per-time slot counts and ctx: scripts/config_loader.py (_normalize), scripts/bucketing.py (schedule_from_config), scripts/reporting.py (ctx_by_time), scripts/recommendations.py (advice pointing at 'proxy/config.yaml slot_schedule').

Impact: with no slot_schedule key, config_loader omits it and bucketing falls back to a single 'fast' bucket with default_slots (session_slot_pool_size) for the whole day — the cheap (2-slot) vs fast (3-slot) slot-count split is lost.

Required work (in the skill directory, per .pi boundary this item must be explicitly authorized):
- Derive per-mode slot counts from the mode profiles' static session_slot_pool_size (fast 3 / cheap 2) instead of schedule entries.
- Replace ctx_by_time semantics with the profiles' static local_model_ctx_size.
- Update recommendations text that references 'proxy/config.yaml slot_schedule'.
- Update skill tests/fixtures accordingly.
data.title: proxy-usage-analysis: drop slot_schedule dependency after per-mode slot-count simplification

data.description:
# Consolidate and document the provider fallback-chain configuration model

discovered-from:LP-0MVDVK5TM004TQQV

## Goal (user story)

As the proxy operator, I want **one** authoritative description of the provider
fallback model — every knob that shapes a chain, the layer it applies at
(provider entry / model / server), and the order those layers win in — so I can
answer "how do I control X for model Y?" without reading `provider.py`, and so
new controls (e.g. per-model budget knobs, `LP-0MVDVK5TM004TQQV`) slot into a
documented contract instead of inventing a new shape.

Low priority: documentation/consolidation only, no behaviour change.

## Current state (fragmented)

Fallback behaviour is described in five places that have drifted apart:
`proxy/config.yaml` header comments, `proxy/README.md`, `proxy/MODEL_ADD.md`,
`proxy/docs/routing.md` and inline code comments in `proxy/proxy/provider.py` /
`provider_budget.py`. The knobs themselves are spread across three layers with
no single statement of precedence:

| Layer | Examples | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Provider entry | `rate_limit_rpm`, `available_times`, `endpoint`, `api_key_env`, `forward_session_headers`, `api`, `system_prompt`, `budget` (proposed) | per-entry, order defines chain position |
| Model (`models.<name>`) | `providers` list order, `aliases`, `system_prompt`, `budget` (proposed) | one model key → one chain, shared by all aliases |
| Server (`server.*`) | `provider_cooldown_seconds`, `sibling_fallback_*`, `chain_hold_*`, `upstream_*`, `provider_rate_limit_*`, `provider_affinity_ttl_seconds`, `max_retry_after_seconds` | global; some are inherited-only across mode overlays |
| Mode overlay | `config-fast.yaml`, `config-cheap.yaml` | lists replace wholesale; other values replace; only diffs declared |
| Runtime | cooldowns, usage-limit quarantine, stall circuit breaker, affinity records, budget windows | in-memory + `proxy/provider-state.json` |

Cross-cutting semantics that are easy to get wrong and belong in one place:
failure-domain grouping (shared endpoint+model), per-account vs per-endpoint
exclusion, time windows (`available_times`), the free-tier budget gate
(`LP-0MVDQ1GMO00801PL`, `LP-0MVDUN5CY009VD20`) including the reserve and
affinity, chain-hold retry cycles, sibling-fallback circuit breaker,
mode grandfathering, and which of these reset on proxy restart (in-memory vs
persisted).

## Desired change

1. A single reference document (e.g. `proxy/docs/provider-fallback-model.md`)
   covering: chain resolution order, every knob with its layer + default +
   precedence, the failure/cooldown/quarantine taxonomies, quota/budget gating,
   mode overlays and grandfathering, and what is persisted vs in-memory.
2. `proxy/README.md` and `proxy/MODEL_ADD.md` link to it instead of duplicating
   the detail (keep short, task-focused sections there).
3. A short "inconsistencies / gaps" section recording anything found while
   writing it (knobs only available globally, provider lists duplicated in the
   fast overlay, budget gating only on one entry, etc.) — recorded as
   `discovered-from` work items rather than fixed here.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `proxy/docs/provider-fallback-model.md` exists and states, for every
   fallback-related knob: name, layer, default, precedence, and the behaviour it
   controls — verified against the code paths that read it (no invented values).
2. A precedence table covers entry > model (where applicable) > server >
   built-in default, including the mode-overlay merge rule (lists replace,
   scalars replace, dicts merge) and the `BASE_ONLY_SERVER_KEYS` inheritance
   contract.
3. The persistence section distinguishes state that survives a restart
   (`provider-state.json`, grandfathered bindings) from in-memory state
   (cooldowns, stall breaker, affinity, budget windows).
4. `proxy/README.md` and `proxy/MODEL_ADD.md` link to the new document and no
   longer contradict it.
5. Every inconsistency found is either fixed by a linked `discovered-from` item
   or explicitly recorded as accepted.
6. All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code
   comments where a pointer to the new document replaces duplicated prose.
7. Full project test suite passes (documentation-only change must not perturb
   behaviour).

## Constraints

- Documentation/analysis only: no behaviour, config-value or code-path changes in
  this item.
- Do not duplicate the new budget-gate material — reference
  `LP-0MVDQ1GMO00801PL` / `LP-0MVDUN5CY009VD20` and the per-model controls item
  (`LP-0MVDVK5TM004TQQV`) rather than restating their designs.
- UK English, Markdown, no secrets (reference API keys by env-var name only).

## Key Files (predicted)

- `proxy/docs/provider-fallback-model.md` — new reference document.
- `proxy/README.md`, `proxy/MODEL_ADD.md`, `proxy/docs/routing.md` — link + trim
  duplicated material.
- `proxy/config.yaml` — header comments point at the document.
- `proxy/proxy/provider.py`, `proxy/proxy/provider_budget.py` — verify claims;
  replace duplicated comments with pointers only where clearly redundant.

## Related work

- `LP-0MVDVK5TM004TQQV` — per-model budget knobs (the contract this document
  should describe once it lands).
- `LP-0MVDQ1GMO00801PL`, `LP-0MVDUN5CY009VD20` — the free-tier budget gate,
  reserve and wait cap.
- `LP-0MVDVJYN5001BMG4` — whether `rate_limit_rpm` should be raised.
- `LP-0MVDNP36J006430L` — header-derived budgeting.
- `LP-0MVDQKF4F008LGS6` — free tier restricted to cheap mode.
data.title: Consolidate and document the provider fallback-chain configuration model
